# PixelPlugins

> PixelPlugins is a San Diego-based, business-first technology partner that helps companies plan, design, build, integrate, modernize, and grow professional business websites, dependable SaaS platforms, AI systems, mobile and web applications, BuildFire plugins, and Shopify solutions.

PixelPlugins builds real, shipped software, not prototypes. Its core team brings hands-on technology experience dating back to 2009, spanning early platform work at BuildFire and Flywheel, custom systems built on Shopify, and products built and operated in-house. Proof includes DMNexa (a live AI order-assistant app on iOS, Android, and web, designed and operated end to end by PixelPlugins), a Shopify loyalty integration built as a custom private app, and BuildFire plugins including Popup Notifications (PixelPlugins' most-used BuildFire plugin) and an AI chatbot plugin. Based in San Diego, CA.

PixelPlugins has delivered custom B2B software and SaaS platforms across insurance, fintech, telecom, healthcare, food tech, e-commerce, and delivery/logistics — see the Industries section below.

PixelPlugins also designs and develops professional company websites, marketing websites, lead-generation websites, and website redesigns. Website engagements can include custom design, SEO-ready technical foundations, content-management workflows, forms, CRM and scheduling integrations, analytics, launch support, and ongoing maintenance.

The working model is partnership rather than a one-time technical handoff: PixelPlugins starts with the business goal, recommends a right-sized roadmap, owns implementation, and can maintain and improve the website or software after launch.
